items.title: Assistant answers from HR and finance pages the asking employee may not be allowed to read
Index keeps content after a page is restricted, deleted or an employee leaves
Unbounded querying runs up LLM and embedding cost or starves the service
No record of which sensitive pages were revealed to which employee
HR and finance page text plus employee questions are sent out to the LLM for every answer
Planted or outdated wiki page is restated by the assistant as authoritative HR or finance policy
